body.name: Mlin
body.def: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{Lin}}\) denotes the underlying conditional-optimal-transport information model associated with Lin et al. (2025): it is the class of probability laws \(P\) for which the observable arm laws \(\mathcal L_P(X,Y_0)\) and \(\mathcal L_P(X,Y_1)\) share the same pretreatment-covariate marginal. It does not denote the compact-support theorem class imposed for particular results in Lin et al. (2025).
